unit_title: ምዕራፍ ፲ — Meraf 10: Grand Master of ገ and ጠ

success_screen.headline_en: Spectacular! You are the Grand Master of ገ and ጠ!
success_screen.headline_am: ግሩም ድንቅ ነው! የገ እና የጠ የደረጃ ፫ ዋና ጠቢብ ሆኑ!

games.title: Grand Decoder: GARI
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'GARI' (Cart) with the correct Amharic word.

games.title: Grand Finish: ጡሩምባ
games.instructions_en: Look closely at the word 'Trumpet' (Turumba). Find the correct missing first-form related letter: [ ? ]ሩምባ.
games.tips_en: The full word is ጡሩምባ (pronounced Tu-rum-ba).

games.title: Master Sequence Check
games.instructions_en: Grand Master skip pattern! Look at the pattern: 2nd form ➔ 4th form ➔ [ ? ] (6th form). What goes next?

games.title: Grand Builder: ጡሩምባ
games.instructions_en: Assemble the letters correctly to spell the Amharic word for Trumpet (Turumba)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 'ጡ' first, then 'ሩ', followed by sixth form 'ም' and fourth form 'ባ'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: TURUMBA
games.instructions_en: Match the phonetic spelling 'TURUMBA' (Trumpet) with the correct Amharic word counterpart.

games.title: Grand Audio Blend: ጥ
games.instructions_en: Listen closely to the emphatic native 6th form 'T' sound of the ጠ family. Which symbol matches this silent/stopped form?

games.title: Grand Builder: ገበታ
games.instructions_en: Form the full Amharic word for Table/Platter (Gebeta)!
games.tips_en: Tip: Select 1st form 'ገ', follow with 1st form 'በ', and end with 4th form 'ታ'!

games.title: Grand Decoder: GEBETA
games.instructions_en: Match the native English phonetic spelling 'GEBETA' (Platter) with the correct Amharic word.
